title: Voluntary Housing Refund
description: Allows you to return any CPF savings used for your home purchase to your CPF account while still owning your property. Doing so reduces the refund amount you would have to make and increases the cash proceeds you would get when you eventually sell or transfer your property. This also boosts your retirement savings as you can benefit from CPF interest rates.
highlights: Grow your retirement savings with CPF interest rates
Greater cash proceeds and lower required CPF refund upon property sale or transfer

sections.About this support:
- Receive more cash proceeds and refund less to your CPF account when selling or transferring your property
- Take advantage of CPF’s interest rates and retire with more
- Re-use CPF savings for the various CPF approved schemes if needed
sections.Who is this for?:
- You have used your Ordinary Account (OA) savings to purchase your property
- Please note the following conditions when making the voluntary housing refund:
  - You can refund up to the CPF principal amount withdrawn towards the property plus its accrued interest to your CPF account
  - If you are an undischarged bankrupt, you have to obtain the Official Assignee’s approval to make this housing refund
  - While housing grants will generally be refunded to your OA if you have an HDB flat, the grant(s) may be partially credited to your Special Account / Retirement Account and MediSave Account if you have received more than $30,000 in grant(s)
  - If you are 55 and above, the refunded amount [will be used to meet your Full Retirement Sum (FRS)](http://www.cpf.gov.sg/VHRAge55), which supports your retirement needs through monthly payouts
  - Any refunds beyond your cohort’s FRS will remain in your OA
- You can read more on [housing refunds and their processes](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/infohub/educational-resources/sales-proceeds-after-selling-your-home)
sections.How to apply?:
Check the amount of voluntary refund you can make under the “What happens if” section in your [Home ownership dashboard](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/homeownershipdashboard).

You can make the voluntary housing refund through the following methods:

- Log in to [my cpf digital services](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/tools-and-services/forms-e-applications/make-a-voluntary-housing-refund) using your Singpass:
  - Choose your property and enter a refund amount

Or

- Use the CPF Mobile app:
  - Download the CPF Mobile app
  - Log in with your Singpass
  - Tap on 'Services'
  - Choose 'Voluntary Housing Refund'
sections.Where to go:
[Visit your nearest branch](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/contact-us/visit-us)

Note: By appointment only
sections.Phone number:
CPF hotline: [1800-227-1188](tel:1800-227-1188)

To avoid waiting on the line, you may book an appointment [here](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/appt/oas/form).

title: Home Protection Scheme (HPS)
description: Mortgage-reducing insurance that protects you and your loved ones from losing your Housing and Development Board (HDB) flat in the event of death, terminal illness, or total permanent disability.
highlights: Payout up to the sum assured will be made to HDB or the mortgagee directly
Processing of claim application generally takes 5 working days upon CPF Board's receipt of requested documents

sections.About this support:
**For claims under death grounds**

- HPS benefits will be paid in a lump sum (based on the share of HPS cover) to HDB or the mortgagee directly to settle the outstanding housing loan.
  - Any excess claim amounts will be paid to the insured member's CPF Ordinary Account.
  - Thereafter, the deceased member’s CPF savings will be distributed to nominees, or next-of-kins depending on whether there is a valid nomination made.

**For claims admitted under medical grounds**

- Housing instalments (based on the share of HPS cover) may be paid by HPS for a period of up to two years, before a review of insured member's eligibility to claim the remaining insured sum in full is carried out.
sections.Who is this for?:
CPF members who own a HDB flat and are HPS policyholders paying their monthly housing instalments using CPF savings or cash are eligible to apply for HPS coverage.

- HPS claim payout is made to:
  - Next-of-kin of HPS policyholder who is deceased, or
  - HPS policyholder who is certified by a registered medical practitioner under the Medical Registration Act to be suffering from:
    - Terminal illness: an illness that is likely to result in the death of the insured CPF member within 12 months
    - Total permanent disability: the inability to take part in any employment permanently, or the total permanent loss of physical function of any of the following:
      - Both eyes, or
      - Two limbs, or
      - One eye and one limb
sections.How to apply?:
[Apply online for HPS coverage](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/tools-and-services/forms-e-applications/apply-adjust-home-protection-scheme-cover) via the CPF website with your Singpass.

**Claim on death grounds**

- If the insured member has an outstanding housing loan, CPF Board will automatically assess the deceased’s claim eligibility upon Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA)'s notification.
- CPF Board will inform the co-owner(s) or the insured's next-of-kin of the outcome and if additional information is required.

**Claim on medical grounds**

- Submit your application to CPF Board directly via the [CPF website](http://cpf.gov.sg/applyrleandclaimhpsdps)

title: CPF Housing Scheme
description: Enables CPF members to use their Ordinary Account (OA) savings to buy properties and pay for various housing purchase-related costs if they are owners of the property.
highlights: Use CPF Ordinary Account (OA) savings to buy properties or pay for housing purchase-related costs

sections.About this support:
- Enables members to use their OA savings to buy residential property in Singapore
- OA savings can be used to cover downpayments, housing loans, stamp and legal fees and Home Protection Scheme premiums (for HDB flats)
sections.Who is this for?:
- The amount of OA savings members can use depends on several factors, including the remaining lease of the property, the type of housing loan you’re taking, the age of the youngest owner using CPF, and the number of properties you are using CPF for
- For detailed information on the terms and conditions, please refer to the [terms and conditions for use of CPF savings under the CPF Housing Scheme](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/tnc/t-c-for-use-of-cpf-under-cpf-housing-scheme)
- Upon sale, transfer or disposal of the property (during your lifetime), you are required to refund the CPF principal amount withdrawn together with the accrued interest to your CPF account(s)
- If you are aged 55 or above and have pledged the property to make up your retirement sum, you will also be required to refund the pledged amount
sections.How to apply?:
- To use your OA savings for the property, HDB or the lawyer acting for you in the purchase must submit an application to the CPF Board with your CPF withdrawal details, along with any required documentation
- [Know how much OA you can use](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/home-ownership/using-your-cpf-to-buy-a-home)
- Before your OA savings can be used, you may need to pay certain amounts in cash, [depending on the type of property and housing loan](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/service/article/can-i-use-my-cpf-savings-for-the-down-payment-of-my-property)
- Note that the savings withdrawn are paid to the property developer, HDB, sellers, banks, lawyers or such other entities on your behalf
- To adjust or stop your OA savings for your loan payments, log in to your HDB e-Services if you have an HDB loan or [myCPF](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/houseinstalment) if you have a bank loan

title: U-Save
description: Quarterly rebates to offset HDB households’ utilities expenses. In FY2026, eligible households will receive up to $760 in U-Save rebates.
highlights: Up to $190 of additional U-Save rebates (Oct 2026 and Jan 2027) for eligible HDB households
Total of $440 to $760 in U-Save rebates for eligible HDB households in FY2026
No application needed

sections.About this support:
**2026 Additional U-Save**

- $110 to $190 for eligible HDB households on top of GSTV – U-Save in October 2026 and January 2027
- Will be credited to eligible households at the same time as the GSTV – U-Save, in October 2026 and January 2027

**GST Voucher (GSTV) – U-Save**

- $220 to $380 in GSTV – U-Save for eligible HDB households
- Will be credited in April, July, October 2026, and January 2027

**Budget 2026 U-Save**

- $110 to $190 for eligible HDB households on top of GSTV – U-Save, which helps households with utilities expenses, cushioning the impact of higher utility bills due to an increase in carbon tax from 2026
- Will be credited to eligible households at the same time as the GSTV – U-Save, in April and July 2026
sections.Who is this for?:
- Singaporean households living in HDB flats
- If the HDB flat is partially rented out or not rented out, there must be at least 1 Singapore Citizen owner or occupier in the household
- If the entire HDB flat is rented out, there must be at least 1 Singapore Citizen tenant
- Household members living in the same flat must not own or have any interest in more than 1 property
sections.How to apply?:
- No application needed
- U-Save will be credited directly into eligible households’ utilities accounts with SP Services
sections.Agency website:
- [GSTV – U-Save](https://www.govbenefits.gov.sg/)
- Budget 2026 U-Save: More details will be provided when available

title: Silver Housing Bonus (SHB)
description: Seniors aged 55 or above may receive cash bonus when they right-size to a 3-room or smaller HDB flat, and top-up the proceeds from the sale of their existing property into their CPF Retirement Account (RA) and join CPF LIFE.
highlights: Receive CPF monthly payouts for as long as they live, under CPF LIFE
Application must be submitted within 1 year from date of completion of the second housing transaction

sections.About this support:
- With effect from 1 December 2025, the SHB has been enhanced to provide greater support to seniors.
- Seniors can supplement their retirement income if they right-size from a HDB flat or private residential property with an Annual Value (AV) up to $31,000 and buy a 3-room or smaller HDB flat.
- Seniors who commit to a net increase of up to $60,000* in their CPF RA after right-sizing, with the sum going towards their retirement payouts, can qualify for an SHB amount of $30,000. They can do so using their CPF housing refunds**, if sufficient, and may no longer need to make the top-up in cash.
- They can qualify for an additional $10,000 cash bonus if they right-size to a 2-room or smaller flat, including a Community Care Apartment (CCA). This additional $10,000 bonus applies regardless of the amount they commit to their CPF RA.
- Overall, the maximum SHB amount that eligible seniors may receive is $40,000. Visit [HDB InfoWEB](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/managing-my-home/retirement-planning/monetising-flat-for-retirement/silver-housing-bonus) for more details

* The net increase to commit in your CPF RA depends on the net sale proceeds and is capped at $60,000 per household. It is further capped by the prevailing Full Retirement Sum (FRS).

** CPF principal amount withdrawn to purchase a property and the accrued interest that needs to be refunded after selling the property.
sections.Who is this for?:
- At least 1 owner must be a Singapore Citizen (SC)
- The SC is aged 55 or above
- Monthly household income not more than $16,000
- Existing property is an HDB flat (met minimum occupation period for resale flat), or a private residential property with an Annual Value of up to $31,000
- No concurrent ownership or interest in a private residential property or in more than 1 non-residential property

Other conditions:

- Next property you are buying is a 3-room (excluding 3-room terrace) or smaller flat from HDB or from the resale market
- You must have positive net sale proceeds
- Booking of new HDB flat or application to buy resale flat must either be before sale of existing residential property, or within 12 months of completing the sale of the existing residential property
- SHB application must be submitted within 1 year from the legal completion date of the second housing transaction (either the purchase or sale)
sections.How to apply?:
- Learn about your eligibility for this scheme (and other housing monetisation options) and the estimated monthly payouts you can receive via [HDB’s 'Check Housing Monetisation Option' e-Service](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/webapp/BR05AWEnquireHMOptions)
- To apply:
  - Enquire with our Customer Relations Executive during the appointment for second housing transaction (either resale completion or new flat keys collection appointment)
  - HDB will then schedule a financial counselling session where all the details and information such as the CPF top-up amount, bonus and the monthly payout amount would be shared during the session

title: Housing Loan from HDB
description: Provides eligible buyers with financing via housing loan to purchase or take over ownership of a HDB flat.
highlights: Eligibility for up to 75% Loan-to-Value (LTV) limit for new and resale flats
Monthly instalments capped at 30% of applicants' monthly income
Concessionary interest rate for HDB housing loans

sections.About this support:
- LTV limit of up to 75% for new and resale flats
- Monthly instalments capped at 30% of the applicants' monthly income
- Concessionary interest rate for HDB housing loans
- Option to use CPF savings to pay for the loan
- Applicants may also retain their savings or use them to pay for CPF Home Protection Insurance
sections.Who is this for?:
- At least 1 applicant must be a Singapore Citizen (SC)
- The core member(s)* in the HFE letter application must not have previously taken 2 or more housing loans from HDB
- Singles aged 35 and above who are buying a 2-room Flexi flat on 99-year lease from HDB or a 5-room or smaller resale flat
- Senior citizens aged 55 and above who are not applying for a 2-room Flexi flat on a short lease or a Community Care Apartment (CCA)
- Your average gross monthly household income must not exceed:
  - $16,000 for families
  - $24,000 for extended families
  - $8,000 for singles buying under the Single Singapore Citizen (SSC) Scheme
- All persons listed in the application:
  - Cannot own or have an interest in any private residential property, local or overseas
  - Must not have disposed of any private residential property in the last 30 months before the application for an HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter

*Core member(s) refer to the applicant(s) and occupier(s) in an HFE letter application who enable the applicant(s) to qualify for a flat purchase under an eligibility scheme. All core members must remain in the flat application, and physically occupy the flat during the minimum occupation period (MOP) after the flat purchase. Their names cannot be removed.

**Second HDB housing loan**
You must also meet the following additional requirements:

At Point of Flat Purchase
Conditions to Take a Second HDB Housing Loan
You have disposed of the existing flat or private residential property and do not own any HDB flat
You and the essential occupier have to use up to 50% of the cash proceeds from the disposal of the last-owned HDB flat or from private residential property disposed of at least 30 months prior to the HFE letter application.

You may retain up to $20,000 in your CPF Ordinary Account (OA) and use the remaining balance to buy the flat.
You are buying a HDB flat **before** disposing of the existing one
You will be charged the commercial interest rate (pegged to the average non-promotional interest rate for HDB flats offered by the 3 local Financial Institutions (FIs)†) for the housing loan to buy the next flat.

The interest rate will be converted to the concessionary rate after you have disposed of the existing flat and used the CPF refund and up to 50% of the cash proceeds from the disposal to reduce the housing loan amount for the next flat. From the CPF monies refunded, you may retain up to $20,000 in your CPF OA.

†The 3 local FIs are DBS Bank Limited, Overseas-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited, and United Overseas Bank Limited.

Please note that your second HDB housing loan amount will be reduced by the full CPF refund and part of the cash proceeds from the disposal of the following residential properties:

- Existing or last-owned HDB flat
- Last-owned private residential property, disposed of at least 30 months prior to the HFE letter application

The manner of disposal includes the sale, transfer or surrender of a flat or private residential property, or by any other method under the Housing and Development Act or any other written law.

You may read more on how the cash proceeds from the disposal are used on [HDB InfoWEB](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/flat-grant-and-loan-eligibility/housing-loan/housing-loan-from-hdb).
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain a HFE letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/)
- The HFE letter will inform you of your eligibility for purchasing a flat and the amount of housing loan and grants you can receive
- Use the [payment plan calculator](https://homes.hdb.gov.sg/home/calculator/payment-plan) to estimate your budget and payments required

title: Priority Scheme - First-Timer (Parents & Married Couples), FT(PMC) Category
description: To help young families settle down more quickly, additional support will be provided for applicants who qualify for the FT(PMC) category.
highlights: Additional ballot chance for the Build-To-Order (BTO) or Sale of Balance (SBF) exercises, totalling 3 ballot chances for FT(PMC) applicants
First priority for applicants applying for 4-room or smaller BTO flats in Standard projects under the Family and Parenthood Priority Scheme (FPPS)

sections.About this support:
- 1 additional ballot chance, on top of the 2 provided to First-Timer Families, when applying for BTO or SBF flats
- Receive first priority for flats set aside under the Family and Parenthood Priority Scheme (FPPS) when applying for a 4-room or smaller BTO flat in Standard projects
- Learn more about the additional ballot chances that you may receive as a first-timer family when applying for a flat during a [BTO or SBF exercise](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/bto-sbf-and-open-booking-of-flats/process-for-buying-a-new-flat/modes-of-sales).
sections.Who is this for?:
Applicants must meet all of the following criteria:

- Families with at least 1 Singapore Citizen child aged 18 and below, or married couples aged 40 and below (includes married couples who are expecting and have a doctor’s certification of the pregnancy)
- Never owned or sold a residential property before, including a HDB flat
- Did not have a chance to book a BTO or SBF flat in the past 5 years prior to their flat application
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain a HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/) and apply for a flat during BTO or SBF exercises
- You need not request to be considered for FT (PMC). HDB will assess and inform you about your eligibility after you have submitted your flat application

title: Step-Up CPF Housing Grant (Families)
description: Provides a $15,000 Step-Up CPF Housing Grant to eligible second-timer applicants buying a new or resale flat.
highlights: Eligible applicants can receive a grant of $15,000 to offset the flat’s purchase price or reduce the housing loan needed

sections.About this support:
- Supports eligible married couples and families who have taken one housing subsidy and are buying an eligible next flat.
- The $15,000 grant is directly credited into all eligible Singapore Citizen (SC) and Singapore Permanent Resident (SPR) member’s CPF Ordinary Accounts. Only core applicants may use their shares to offset the flat purchase price or reduce the housing loan required.
- Eligible resale flat buyers may also apply for the Proximity Housing Grant (Families).
sections.Who is this for?:
Married couples or families who have taken one housing subsidy and meet the following conditions:

- You currently live in:
  - a 2-room Standard flat bought from HDB after October 2024, or bought on the open market with CPF housing grant(s); or
  - a 2-room unclassified flat in a non-mature estate bought from HDB after October 1995, or bought on the open market with CPF housing grant(s);
  and are buying a 3-room Standard/ unclassified flat in a non-mature estate, from HDB or on the open market.
- You currently live in a flat under the Public Rental Scheme and are buying:
  - from HDB: a 2-room Flexi or 3-room Standard flat, or a 2-room Flexi or 3-room unclassified flat in a non-mature estate; or
  - on the open market: a 2-room or 3-room Standard flat, or a 2-room or 3-room unclassified flat in a non-mature estate.

Non-mature estates include Bukit Batok, Bukit Panjang, Choa Chu Kang, Hougang, Jurong East, Jurong West, Punggol, Sembawang, Sengkang, Tengah, Woodlands, and Yishun.

- At least one core member must have worked continuously for at least 12 months during the assessment period ending 2 months before the HFE letter application, and be working at the time of application.
- Average gross monthly household income must not $8,000
- Must not own, have an interest in or dispose of any private residential property (local or overseas) in the last 30 months
- For resale flats, the remaining lease must be more than 20 years and be sufficient to cover the youngest core applicant and / or core occupier to the age of 95
sections.How to apply?:
- Apply for the HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/) to check your eligibility for this Grant and others
- If you meet the eligibility criteria, you may apply for the grant when submitting your resale application or after you have booked a flat from HDB

title: CPF Housing Grant (Families) - Top-Up Grant
description: Provides up to $40,000 housing grants to eligible families if they had previously received CPF Housing Grant for Singles and now qualify for the CPF Housing Grant for Families.
highlights: Up to $40,000 in Top-Up grant for eligible families
Available to those who previously received a Singles Grant or bought a 2-room Flexi flat as a single, and are now married
Grant is directly credited into all eligible Singapore Citizen and Singapore Permanent Resident members’ CPF Ordinary Accounts

sections.About this support:
- Up to $40,000 in Top-Up Grant
- The applicant applying for the Top-Up Grant may also apply for other grants (e.g. Enhanced Housing Grant and Proximity Housing Grant), if eligible
sections.Who is this for?:
- You must be a Singapore Citizen (SC) aged 21 and above, and your spouse or child is a SC or Singapore Permanent Resident (SPR)
- You have previously received the CPF Housing Grant for Resale Flats (Singles) or bought a 2-room Flexi flat from HDB as a single, with other single citizens, or with a non-resident spouse. You must not have taken any [**housing subsidy**](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/bto-sbf-and-open-booking-of-flats/conditions-after-buying-a-new-flat?anchor=housing-subsidy) other than the Singles Grant or the purchase of a 2-room Flexi flat from HDB.
- Your average gross monthly household income must not exceed:
  - $16,000 if you were a recipient of a Singles Grant who bought an HDB resale flat, or you bought a short-lease 2-room Flexi flat
  - $8,000 if you bought a 2-room Flexi flat on a 99-year lease
- You and your spouse, as well as other persons listed in the application, must not have ownership or interest in any private residential property, local or overseas, and no disposal of such property within the last 30 months prior to the application
- You and your spouse, as well as other persons listed in the application, must not have ownership or interest in more than one non-residential private property, local or overseas, and no disposal of such property within the last 30 months prior to the application
sections.How to apply?: You must [submit your application for Top-Up Grant](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/webapp/AB22AWTopUpGrantWeb/AB22PMain) within 6 months of your marriage registration or spouse/ child becoming a SC/ SPR

title: CPF Housing Grant
description: Provide more support for first-time homebuyers to purchase resale HDB flats.
highlights: Up to $80,000 for eligible first-time homebuyers purchasing resale HDB flats
Increased by $30,000 for eligible First-Timer families purchasing 2-room to 4-room resale HDB flats
Increased by $10,000 for eligible First-Timer families purchasing 5-room or larger resale HDB flats

sections.About this support:
**Eligible First-Timer families**

- Qualify for $80,000 grant when purchasing 2-room to 4-room resale flats
- Qualify for $50,000 grant when purchasing 5-room or larger resale flats

**Eligible First-Timer singles**

- Qualify for $40,000 grant when purchasing 2-room to 4-room resale flats
- Qualify for $25,000 grant when purchasing 5-room resale flats
sections.Who is this for?:
- Applicant must be a Singapore Citizen (SC)
- At least 1 applicant must be a first-timer i.e. have not received any housing subsidy before
- Average gross monthly household income must not exceed:
  - $16,000 for families
  - $24,000 for extended families
  - $8,000 for singles purchasing a flat on their own
- All applicants and occupiers cannot own or have an interest in a private property in the last 30 months prior to flat application
sections.How to apply?: More details on the application can be found on [HDB website](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/flat-grant-and-loan-eligibility/couples-and-families/cpf-housing-grants).

title: Community Care Apartments (CCAs)
description: Senior-friendly housing integrated with care and social services that can be scaled according to care needs and social activities to support seniors who are 55 and above to age independently within the community.
highlights: Homes with pre-installed fittings and senior-friendly design features
Mandatory Basic Service Package (BSP) that provides support from CCA staff, including 24-hour emergency response
Optional paid care and support services that residents may take up based on their needs

sections.About this support:
- Each CCA unit comes with senior-friendly design features such as easy-to-slide partitions for privacy, built-in wardrobe and cabinets for storage, and a wheelchair-accessible bathroom with slip-resistant flooring and grab bars.
- Flexibility to choose a lease ranging from 15 to 45 years (in 5 year increments) as long as it lasts the applicant(s) and their spouse(s) (if any) until at least age 95.
- Eligible first-timers may apply for the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant ([Families](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/flat-grant-and-loan-eligibility/couples-and-families/enhanced-cpf-housing-grant) or [Singles](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/flat-grant-and-loan-eligibility/singles/enhanced-cpf-housing-grant)) for the flat purchase.
- All residents must subscribe to the Basic Service Package (BSP), which includes the help from a CCA staff with simple home fixes, arranging add-on care and support services, and 24-hour emergency response.
- Residents can add on optional services for assistance with Activities of Daily Living (ADL), as well as fall monitoring, housekeeping and meal services.
- Eligible CCA applicants who require permanent assistance with at least one ADL may qualify for means-tested subsidies for relevant BSP components. More details on BSP fees and subsidies are available at [Vanguard Healthcare’s website](https://www.vanguardhealthcare.com.sg/our-services/assisted-living/basic-service-package).
sections.Who is this for?:
- Applicant must be a Singapore Citizen (SC)
- If you are applying with your spouse, or parent(s)/child(ren), at least one of them must be a SC or Singapore Permanent Resident (SPR)
- If your spouse is not an SC or SPR, they must be included as a core occupier
- All applicant(s) and their spouse(s) (if any) must be at least 55 years old at the time of HFE letter application
- Monthly household income should not exceed $16,000

**Other conditions**

- If any person listed in the application owns or has an interest in any HDB flat or private residential property, the property must be disposed of within 6 months from the completion of the flat purchase.
- Applicant(s) and their spouse(s) (if any) are not eligible to buy a CCA if they had previously enjoyed 2 or more housing subsidies, one of which was a Studio Apartment, or a short-lease 2-room Flexi flat or CCA.

**Additional amount payable**

Some applicants will have to make an additional payment on top of the flat price e.g. resale levy. Visit [HDB InfoWeb](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/bto-sbf-and-open-booking-of-flats/finding-a-new-flat/types-of-flats/community-care-apartments) for more details.
sections.How to apply?:
- Apply for an [HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/) early to be informed of your eligibility to buy a CCA and the amounts of CPF housing grants you are eligible for.
- Visit the [**HDB Flat Portal**](http://homes.hdb.gov.sg/) for details on the flats to be offered on our upcoming Build-To-Order (BTO) exercise. For Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) exercise, details on the flats for sale will only be made available during the sales exercise.
- With a valid HFE letter indicating your eligibility for CCA, apply online via the [HDB Flat Portal](https://homes.hdb.gov.sg/home/landing) during the application period of a sales exercise.
- From 4 weeks after the release of the ballot results, you will be invited to book a flat.
- Within 9 months after booking a flat, you will be invited to sign the Agreement for Lease.
- When your booked flat is ready, you will be invited to sign the BSP Agreement and collect the keys.

title: Short-lease 2-room Flexi Flats
description: An affordable housing option for senior citizens (and their spouses) aged 55 and above who wish to right-size and continue living independently.
highlights: Monetisation option to supplement retirement needs
Flexibility to choose a lease ranging from 15 to 45 years (in 5-year increments) as long as it lasts the applicant(s) and their spouse(s) (if any) until at least age 95

sections.About this support:
- Comes with pre-installed senior-friendly fittings such as grab bars and easy-to-slide partitions to separate living and bedroom spaces for privacy
- Applicant(s) may apply for 1 priority scheme to enhance their chances in the computer ballot for a short-lease 2-room Flexi flat:
  - [Senior Priority Scheme (SPS) (near existing home)](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/bto-sbf-and-open-booking-of-flats/process-for-buying-a-new-flat/application/priority-schemes?anchor=sps)
  - [Family Care Scheme (FCS) (Proximity)](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/bto-sbf-and-open-booking-of-flats/process-for-buying-a-new-flat/application/priority-schemes?anchor=fcs-proximity)
  - [Family Care Scheme (FCS) (Joint Balloting)](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/bto-sbf-and-open-booking-of-flats/process-for-buying-a-new-flat/application/priority-schemes?anchor=fcs-joint-balloting)
- Eligible first-timers may apply for the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant ([Families](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/flat-grant-and-loan-eligibility/couples-and-families/enhanced-cpf-housing-grant) or [Singles](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/flat-grant-and-loan-eligibility/singles/enhanced-cpf-housing-grant))
- Eligible buyers may apply for the [Silver Housing Bonus (SHB)](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/managing-my-home/retirement-planning/monetising-flat-for-retirement/silver-housing-bonus) if they are selling their current flat or private housing with an Annual Value not exceeding $21,000 and buying a 3-room or smaller flat
sections.Who is this for?:
- Applicant must be a Singapore Citizen (SC)
- If you are applying with your spouse, or parent(s)/child(ren), at least one of them must be a SC or Singapore Permanent Resident (SPR)
- If your spouse is not an SC or SPR, they must be included as a core occupier
- All applicant(s) and their spouse(s) (if any) must be at least 55 years old at the time of HFE letter application
- Monthly household income should not exceed $16,000

**Other conditions**

- If any person listed in the application owns or has an interest in any HDB flat or private residential property, the property must be disposed of within 6 months from the completion of the flat purchase.
- Applicant(s) and their spouse(s) (if any) are not eligible to buy a short-lease 2-room Flexi flat if they had previously enjoyed 2 or more housing subsidies, one of which was a Studio Apartment, or a short-lease 2-room Flexi flat or Community Care Apartment (CCA).

**Additional amount payable**

Some applicants will have to make an additional payment on top of the flat price e.g. resale levy. Visit [HDB InfoWeb](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/flat-grant-and-loan-eligibility/seniors) for more details.
sections.How to apply?:
- Apply for an [HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/) early to be informed of your eligibility to buy a short-lease 2-room Flexi flat and the amounts of CPF housing grants you are eligible for.
- Visit the [HDB Flat Portal](http://homes.hdb.gov.sg/) for details on the flats to be offered on our upcoming Build-To-Order (BTO) exercise. For Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) exercise, details on the flats for sale will only be made available during the sales exercise.
- With a valid HFE letter indicating your eligibility for a short-lease 2-room Flexi flat, apply online via the [HDB Flat Portal](https://homes.hdb.gov.sg/home/landing) during the application period of a sales exercise.
- From 4 weeks after the release of the ballot results, you will be invited to book a flat.
- Within 9 months after booking a flat, you will be invited to sign the Agreement for Lease.
- When your booked flat is ready, you will be invited to collect the keys.

title: New/Resale Flats (Singles)
description: Helps eligible singles decide if new or resale flats would be suitable for their consideration and provides them a holistic understanding of their housing and financing options for these flats.
highlights: Eligible singles may apply for a 2-room Flexi flat from HDB or a resale flat on the open market
Various housing grants are available in addition to the housing loan. Eligible first-timer singles may receive housing grants of up to $60,000 for new flats, and up to $115,000 for resale flats.

sections.About this support:
Eligible singles may:

- Apply for new 2-room Flexi flats (99-year lease) in all locations, across Standard, Plus and Prime projects
- Buy an Unclassified/ Standard or Plus resale flat of any size, excluding 3Gen flats
- Buy a 2-room resale Prime flat
- Access to various housing grants for eligible singles
sections.Who is this for?:
**Singles/ Two or more singles**

All applicant(s) must:

- Be Singapore Citizen (SC) or include at least 1 other co-applicant who is an SC (if applying jointly).

**If buying a new flat**

- At least 35 years old
- Monthly household income ceiling not exceeding $8,000
- Have not taken any housing subsidy
- Must not own, or have an interest in or dispose of any private residential property (local or overseas) in the last 30 months
- An additional amount is payable if you are buying a new flat alone
- Flat types available: 2-room Flexi flat (99-year lease)

**If buying a resale flat**

- At least 21 years old (widowed or an orphan) or at least 35 years old (unmarried or divorced)
- For Unclassified/ Standard flat: No income ceiling (Income ceiling applies to qualify for HDB housing loan and CPF housing grants [excluding Proximity Housing Grant])
- For Plus flat: Monthly household income ceiling not exceeding $16,000
- For Prime flat: Monthly household income ceiling not exceeding $8,000
- Must not own, or have an interest in or dispose of any private residential property (local or overseas) in the last 30 months if you are buying a resale flat with CPF housing grants
- Flat types available:
  - All flat types (excluding 3Gen flats) in any location
  - Up to 5-room if applying for CPF housing grants
sections.How to apply?:
- Apply for a HFE letter by visiting the [HDB Flat Portal](https://homes.hdb.gov.sg/home/landing)
- The letter will support you to acquire a holistic understanding of your housing and financing options, inform you on your eligibility to purchase new or resale flats and determine the amount of CPF housing grants and HDB housing loan you are eligible for

title: Executive Condominiums (ECs)
description: Provides a more affordable option to eligible Singaporean households who aspire to own private housing.
highlights: ECs are strata-titled and are developed and sold by private developers
With design features and facilities similar to private condominiums

sections.About this support:
- Eligible households can purchase an EC unit from a property developer at a subsidised rate
- Eligible first-timer households may qualify for the CPF Housing Grant
sections.Who is this for?:
**For fiancé or fiancée, married couples and/ or parent(s) with child(ren), orphaned siblings:**

- Applicant must:
  - Be a Singapore Citizen (SC)
  - Include at least 1 other SC or Singapore Permanent Resident (SPR)
  - Be at least 21 years old

**For 2 or more singles applying jointly:**

- All applicants must be:
  - SCs
  - At least 35 years old

**Monthly household income ceiling:**

- The total income of all persons listed in the EC application for new units in EC projects with tenders closing on or after 24 August 2026 must not exceed $18,000*
  *The income ceiling for new units in EC sites with tenders awarded before 24 August 2026 is $16,000.

**Private residential property:**

- Must not own, have an interest in or dispose of any private residential property (local or overseas) in the last 30 months

**Housing subsidies and Resale Levy:**

- If any core applicants/ occupiers have taken a housing subsidy, they are considered second-timers.
- All second-timer core applicants / occupiers will need to pay their respective [resale levies](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/bto-sbf-and-open-booking-of-flats/conditions-after-buying-a-new-flat?anchor=resale-levy) if applicable, when buying an EC unit from a property developer
- If any core applicants/ occupiers have taken 2 housing subsidies, they are not eligible to apply for or be listed as a core occupier in an EC application
sections.How to apply?:
- Submit your [application](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/executive-condominiums/process-for-buying-an-ec) when the EC project is launched
- Contact the property developer directly for details on the application process and required documents
- The property developer will inform you of the outcome of the application

title: Safe Place
description: Programme aims to empower women and their families with unsupported pregnancies to make informed and life-giving choices.

sections.About this support:
The programme provides the following services:

- Case management and counselling
- Pre- and postnatal skills equipping
- Baby essentials
- Temporary accommodation
- Referrals to other support partners
sections.Who is this for?: Safe Place serves pregnant women up to 32 weeks gestation who consent to receiving support services. For clients under 17 years, parental consent is required, although exceptions are considered based on individual circumstances.
sections.How to apply?:
If you are a pregnant woman who needs help, know of one who needs help or need information about unsupported pregnancy, please contact Safe Place at 6817 4202 or text via WhatsApp at 8891 4214 to speak to the caseworkers.

For community partners, please submit a referral form and attach a social report (if available) via email ([safeplace@lakeside.org.sg](mailto:safeplace@lakeside.org.sg)).

A social worker will be in touch within 3 working days.
sections.What to expect?:
Service users who require help with their pregnancy may contact Safe Place via email/call/WhatsApp.

Case plans and duration of case are customised to meet the unique needs and circumstances of the service users.

title: Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme (PPHS)
description: Provides temporary housing for families as they await the completion of their new flats.
highlights: Rent a flat from HDB while waiting for your uncompleted HDB flat
Subsidised rental rates range between $400 to $1,500 for 2-, 3- or 4-room flats
Eligible households may submit applications online

sections.About this support:
- To rent a flat from HDB at a subsidised rate while waiting for your flat to be completed
- Rental rates depend on the location and flat type, and can range from $400 to $1,500 per month
sections.Who is this for?:
- Singapore Citizen who is with another Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident in the PPHS household
- Booked an uncompleted flat under HDB's sales exercises as a married couple, under the Fiance/Fiancee scheme, or as a divorced or widowed parent with children
- All members of the PPHS household must not own an existing HDB flat
- Monthly household income of less than or equal to $8,000
sections.How to apply?: You can apply online at the [HDB website](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/renting-a-flat/parenthood-provisional-housing-scheme/application-process). PPHS application window will be from the 1st to the 14th of even months (Feb, Apr, Jun, Aug, Oct, Dec).

title: Equipment Rental Scheme (ERS)
description: Subsidises the rental of essential care equipment for patients with serious illnesses.
highlights: Subsidised weekly rental fees for essential medical equipment
Covers up to two-way transport and essential consumables

sections.About this support:
The Equipment Rental Scheme (ERS) provides patients with serious illnesses who have a prognosis of less than a year with the following subsidies:

- Weekly rental fees for approved equipment such as wheelchair/pushchair, hospital bed, oxygen concentrator, pressure relief mattress and commode
- Cost of two-way transport for delivery and collection of rented equipment
sections.Who is this for?:
- Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident
- Currently receiving care from a palliative care provider, whether home-based or in a public healthcare institution (PHI).
- Diagnosed to have a serious illness with a prognosis of less than a year.
- Assessed by a qualified assessor on the type(s) of equipment required.
- *Must not be receiving subsidies for the same or similar equipment through other Government assistance schemes.

*If you have previously received Government assistance or subsidies for same or similar type of equipment prior to your ERS application, eligibility to rent equipment(s) under ERS will be assessed on a case-by-case basis.
sections.How to apply?:
Approach the [home palliative care provider](https://www.aic.sg/Care-Services/Home-Palliative-Care) or PHI you are receiving care from to apply for ERS.

If you are currently not under the care of any home palliative care provider or PHI, you can reach out to [Singapore Hospice Council](https://www.singaporehospice.org.sg/#contact-pop).
sections.Where to go: [Visit the AIC Link branch nearest to you](https://www.aic.sg/about-us/aic-link-locations/)
sections.Phone number:
AIC Hotline: [1800 650 6060](tel:1800-650-6060)

Calls from AIC Hotline may be reflected as 6650 6060 on your caller ID.

title: Proximity Housing Grant (Families)
description: Provides up to $30,000 for families buying a resale flat to live with or near parents or children.
highlights: Grant of $30,000 to live with your parents or child
Grant of $20,000 to live near your parents or child (within 4km)
If applicant is living near them, parents/child may reside in either a HDB flat or private residential property to be eligible for PHG

sections.About this support:
- $30,000 grant to live with your parents or child
- $20,000 grant to live near your parents or child (if resale flat is within 4km)
sections.Who is this for?:
- Singapore Citizen (SC) or include at least 1 other SC or Singapore Permanent Resident (SPR)
- At least 21 years
- [Applicants buying a resale flat to live with, or within 4 km of, their parents or child](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/flat-grant-and-loan-eligibility/couples-and-families/proximity-housing-grant)
- Have not received the Proximity Housing Grant (PHG) before
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain a HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/) to check your eligibility for grants and loans
- If you meet the eligibility criteria, you may apply for the grant when submitting your resale application

title: Service and Conservancy Charges (S&CC) Rebate
description: Quarterly rebates to offset S&CC fees for HDB households. Eligible households will receive 1.5 to 3.5 months of the GST Voucher (GSTV) – S&CC Rebate.
highlights: 1.5 to 3.5 months of S&CC Rebate in each Financial Year
Rebates will be given out in January, April, July and October
No application needed

sections.About this support:
- Offsets between 1.5 and 3.5 months of S&CC
- Eligible households will receive their S&CC rebates in January, April, July, and October
sections.Who is this for?:
A HDB household will be eligible for the S&CC rebate if all the criteria below are fulfilled:

- There must be at least one Singapore Citizen flat owner or occupier in the flat
- The flat owner(s) and essential occupier(s) of the flat do not own or have any interest in a private property
- The flat owner(s) have not rented out the whole flat
sections.How to apply?:
- No application required
- S&CC rebates will be credited directly to your household's S&CC account managed by your respective Town Council
sections.Email / Form: HDB residents can check or enquire about their household's eligibility for GSTV – S&CC Rebate using these e-Services for [purchased flats](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/webapp/AG10AWScRebate/AG10SRebatesMain) and [rental flats](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/webapp/AG10AWScRebate/AG10SRentalRebatesMain).

title: CPF Housing Grant for Executive Condominiums (ECs)
description: Provides up to $30,000 subsidy for eligible first-timer applicants buying an Executive Condominium (EC).
highlights: CPF Housing Grant of up to $30,000 for eligible first-timer household
Grant can be used to offset EC purchase price or reduce required housing loan

sections.About this support:
- Housing subsidy of up to $30,000 for eligible first-timer recipients purchasing an EC from a property developer
  - The Grant can be used to offset the EC’s purchase price or reduce the required housing loan for it
sections.Who is this for?:
- Your core family nucleus must include at least 1 first-timer applicant who has not received any housing subsidies before
- Applicants must be Singapore Citizens at least 21 years old
- The household must include at least 1 other Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident
- All applicants and occupiers must have no ownership or interest in private property locally or overseas in the last 30 months
- All persons listed in the application can, as a household, own up to 1 non-residential property
- Grant amount eligibility will be [determined by your household’s average monthly household income (includes all applicants and occupiers listed in the EC application)](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/executive-condominiums/cpf-housing-grant)
- All members of the core family nucleus will receive equal shares of the grant, fully credited into their CPF Ordinary Accounts
- Only core applicants can use their grants to pay for the EC unit purchase
sections.How to apply?: Contact the property developer directly for details on the application process and required documents.

title: Housing Loan from Financial Institutions (FI)
description: Supports your flat purchase through housing loans from Financial Institutions (FI) regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.
highlights: Loan-to-Value (LTV) limit up to 75% of the flat’s purchase price / resale price and value
Repayment period up to 30 years

sections.About this support:
- LTV limit of up to 75% for both new and resale flats
- Repayment period of up to 30 years
- Option to use any amount in OA for flat purchase, dependent on [certain applicable limits](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/buying-a-flat/flat-grant-and-loan-eligibility/housing-loan/housing-loan-from-financial-institutions)
- Can refinance the housing loan with another loan from a different FI or a different interest rate package
sections.Who is this for?:
- Applicants must pay at least 5% of the flat price or flat value (whichever is lower) in cash. The minimum cash payment is dependent on applicants’ age, loan period and whether there are any outstanding housing loans
- Applicants who want to purchase a unit from a property developer under the Executive Condominium Housing Scheme must take a housing loan from an FI
- LTV limit is up to 75% of the flat purchase price or flat value, whichever is lower. FIs may have restrictions on flat purchase depending on remaining lease of the flat and / or if your repayment period exceeds 25 years or you have additional housing loan(s)
sections.How to apply?:
- [Compare housing loan packages from participating Fis](https://homes.hdb.gov.sg/home/calculator/budget)
- Apply early for an In-Principle Approval (IPA) from participating FIs through HDB’s Integrated Loan Application service on the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp28/TimeLine/my-flat-dashboard) for an indicative assessment of your loan eligibility
- You need to obtain a valid Letter of Offer (LO) to confirm the loan offer from an FI before signing Agreement for Lease for a new flat or exercising the Option to Purchase for a resale flat
- Use the integrated loan application service on the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp28/TimeLine/my-flat-dashboard) to apply for IPA and LO)

title: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Singles)
description: Provides up to $60,000 in Enhanced CPF Housing Grants (EHG) (Singles) for eligible first-timer applicants buying a new or resale flat on their own, or with their non-resident spouses.
highlights: EHG (Singles) Grant of up to $60,000 for eligible first-timer applicants
Additional up to $60,000 grant for joint singles scheme (a total of up to $120,000)
Households with lower household incomes will receive a larger grant amount

sections.About this support:
- The EHG (Singles) Grant provides up to $60,000 to offset the purchase price of the flat / reduce the required housing loan for the flat (new or resale)
- Receive a total Grant of up to $120,000 when jointly purchasing flats with other eligible first-timer single applicants (Limited to 2, up to $60,000 each)
sections.Who is this for?:
- First-timer applicants aged 35 or above, who are:
  - buying a HDB flat alone or with other first-timer single citizens
  - buying a resale flat alone, with other first-timer single citizens or with their parents
- First-timer applicants aged 21 or above who are buying a resale flat with their non-resident spouse
- If you are buying a flat with your parents, you and at least 1 parent must be a Singapore Citizen, and both parents must be first-timers and meet all the eligibility conditions
- Applicants have worked continuously for at least 12 months, 2 months before the HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter application, and were employed at the time of the HFE letter application
- Monthly household income not exceeding $4,500 for singles and $9,000 for joint singles, non-resident spouses or your parents (resale flats only)
- Flat has a remaining lease of more than 20 years
- To qualify for the full EHG grant, flat must have sufficient lease for the coverage of the youngest core applicant and occupier to the age of 95
- Must not own, have an interest in or have disposed of any private residential property (local or overseas) within the last 30 months
- All persons listed in the HFE letter application can, as a household, own up to 1 non-residential property at HFE letter application and up to 30 months before HFE letter application
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain an HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/) to determine your eligibility for this Grant as well as others
- If you meet the eligibility criteria, you may apply for the grant when submitting your resale application or after you have booked a flat from HDB
- The Grant will be credited to the CPF Ordinary Accounts of eligible household members
- Only core applicants can use their share of the housing grants to pay for the flat purchase

title: Staggered Downpayment Scheme
description: Eases home purchase by allowing eligible first-timer couples and right-sizing flat owners to pay downpayment in 2 parts.
highlights: Ease home purchase by splitting flat downpayment into two parts
Can pay in cash and / or CPF Ordinary Account (OA) savings

sections.About this support:
- Downpayment split into 2 instalments for easier financial management
- First instalment is paid at the signing of the Agreement for Lease and is either 5% or 10% of the purchase price (depending on your choice of housing loan)
- Second instalment is paid at key collection and is either 20% or 35% of the purchase price (depending on your choice of housing loan and the Loan-To-Value (LTV) limit)
- Can be paid in cash and / or CPF OA savings (including CPF housing grant, if eligible), depending on loan type
- For flat applications received from young couples eligible for deferred income assessment from the Jun 2024 sales exercise:
  - First instalment is capped at 2.5% of the purchase price
  - Second instalment is either 22.5% or 42.5% of the purchase price (depending on your choice of housing loan and the LTV limit)
  - Applicants who acquire a housing loan with a 75% or 55% LTV limit from a Financial Institution will have to pay at least 5% or 10% of the purchase price or value (whichever is lower) in cash before disbursement
sections.Who is this for?:
- First-timer couples, including those with 1 second-timer applicant
- Valid HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter obtained on or before the younger applicant's 30th birthday
- Booked an uncompleted 5-room or smaller flat in any HDB sales exercise
- Flat owners right-sizing to a 3-room or smaller flat in non-mature estates who have not completed the sale of their existing flat at the time of HFE letter application and booked an uncompleted 3-room or smaller flat in a non-mature estate in any HDB sales exercise
sections.How to apply?: Buyers will be informed during the flat booking appointment if they are eligible.

title: Senior Priority Scheme (SPS) (near existing home)
description: Supports seniors in buying a 2-room Flexi flat to live near their existing home.
highlights: Seniors receive priority when they apply for a 2-room Flexi flat to age-in-place near their existing home.

sections.About this support: Seniors who wish to age-in-place near their existing home can enjoy priority access when they apply for a 2-room Flexi flat under the Senior Priority Scheme (near existing home).
sections.Who is this for?: Seniors who wish to buy a 2-room Flexi flat that is within 4km of their owner-occupied property (either HDB flat or private residential property).
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain a HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/)
- If you meet the eligibility criteria during your flat application, you may apply for this scheme in your flat application

title: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Families)
description: Provides up to $120,000 for eligible first-time applicants applying as a family to assist with new or resale flat purchases.
highlights: Up to $120,000 Enhanced CPF Housing Grant for first-timer families
The Grant can be used to offset the flat purchase price or reduce the required housing loan
Households with lower household incomes will receive larger grants

sections.About this support:
- Up to $120,000 for applicants purchasing a new or resale flat as a family
- Up to $60,000 for couples comprising a first-time and second-time applicant
- The grant amount is based on the average gross monthly household income, with lower-income households receiving more support
- The Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (EHG) can be used to:
  - Offset the purchase price of the flat
  - Reduce the housing loan required for the flat purchase
sections.Who is this for?:
- Applicants forming a core family nucleus, consisting of the core applicant(s) and occupier(s)
- Average gross monthly household income of $9,000 or below for first-timer households (including all applicants and occupiers)
- For mixed households (first-timer and second-timer), half of the average gross monthly household income must not exceed $4,500
- If you are buying a flat with your parents, you and at least 1 parent must be a Singapore Citizen, and both parents must be first-timers and meet all the eligibility conditions
- Have worked continuously for at least 12 months, 2 months before the HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter application, and were employed at the time of the HFE letter application
- Flat has a remaining lease of more than 20 years
- To qualify for the full grant, flat must have sufficient remaining lease to cover the youngest core applicant and/or core occupier to the age of 95
- Must not own, have an interest in or disposed of any private residential property (local or overseas) within the last 30 months
- All persons listed in the HFE application can, as a household, own up to 1 non-residential property at HFE letter application and up to 30 months before HFE letter application
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain a HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/) to determine your eligibility for this Grant and others
- If you meet the eligibility criteria, you may apply for the grant when submitting your resale application or after you have booked a flat from HDB
- The Grant will be credited to the CPF Ordinary Accounts of eligible household members
- Only core applicants can use their share of the housing grants to pay for the flat purchase

title: Family and Parenthood Priority Scheme (FPPS)
description: Up to 60% of Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) and up to 40% of Build-To-Order (BTO) flats are made available for eligible first-timer buyers.
highlights: Up to 40% of BTO and 60% of SBF flats reserved for first-timer buyers
If you qualify under the FT(PMC) category, you will be eligible for FPPS
Can apply for both FPPS and 1 other priority scheme simultaneously

sections.About this support:
- Up to 40% of BTO flats and up to 60% of SBF flats are set aside for first-timer buyers
- You can apply for the FPPS priority scheme in addition to 1 other priority scheme
- A computerised ballot is conducted for each priority scheme:
  - For example, if your ballot under the Third Child Priority Scheme is not successful, your application will be balloted again under the FPPS
sections.Who is this for?:
- You and your spouse must be first-timer buyers
- Have a Singapore Citizen child (natural or legally adopted) aged 18 and below
- Expecting a child and have a doctor's certification of pregnancy
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain a HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/)
- If you meet the eligibility criteria during your HFE letter application, you may apply for this scheme in your flat application

title: Fresh Start Housing Scheme
description: Helps families with children who are currently living in public rental flats to own a 2-room Flexi flat or 3-room flat on a shorter lease.
highlights: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant of up to $120,000 for eligible first-timer families
Fresh Start Housing Grant of $75,000 for eligible second-timer families
Resale levy cap of $30,000 for eligible second-timer families
HDB Concessionary Loan is subject to credit assessment

sections.About this support:
**Both first-timer and second-timer families**

- Purchase a 2-room Flexi or 3-room Standard flat on a shorter lease in HDB sales launches i.e. Build-To-Order (BTO) or Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) exercises, or open booking of flats
- HDB Concessionary Loan is subject to credit assessment

**First-timer families**

- Enhanced CPF Housing Grant of up to $120,000

**Second-timer families**

- Fresh Start Housing Grant of $75,000 ($60,000 will be disbursed into CPF Ordinary Accounts before key collection; $15,000 may be disbursed after key collection into CPF Ordinary Accounts over 5 years)
- Resale levy cap of $30,000
sections.Who is this for?:
- Have at least 1 parent and 1 child who are Singapore Citizens
- Applicant and spouse (if applicable) must be aged at least 35 and below 55 years old
- Child must be aged below 21
- Household monthly income of $7,000 and below
- Stayed in public rental flat for at least 1 year
- Have occupied public rental flat for at least 1 year, without accumulating 3 or more months of rental arrears in the preceding 12 months
- Have not received any public rental tenancy discount under Relocation, Sale of Flat to Sitting Tenants, or Rent & Purchase Schemes
- Do not own other properties overseas or locally, and have not disposed of any within the last 30 months
sections.How to apply?: You can apply online at the [HDB website](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/webapp/AA11AWFreshStartAppWeb/AA11PFreshStartNote).

title: Family Care Scheme (FCS) (Proximity)
description: Helps parents and their child(ren), married or single, to live with or near each other for mutual care and support.
highlights: Parents and their child(ren), married or single, enjoy priority access when they apply for a flat to live with or near each other

sections.About this support:
- Seeks to strengthen intergenerational family support by promoting proximity living between parents and children, whether married or single.
- This scheme is also applicable to fiancé/ fiancée applicants.
sections.Who is this for?:
- Married couples, singles above 35, and seniors who wish to apply for a flat to live with or near their parents/ child(ren).
- This scheme is also applicable to fiancé/ fiancée applicants.
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain a HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/)
- If you meet the eligibility criteria during your flat application, you may apply for this scheme in your flat application

title: Housing Subsidy - Citizen Top-Up
description: Provides a $10,000 housing subsidy for eligible Singapore Citizen/ Permanent Resident households when a family member becomes a Singapore Citizen.
highlights: $10,000 housing subsidy for eligible Singapore Citizen/ Permanent Resident households when a household member acquires Singapore citizenship
Citizen Top-Up  is credited into CPF Ordinary Accounts of eligible family members
Can be used for repayment or redemption of housing loan, future HDB flat purchase or CPF withdrawal at age 55

sections.About this support:
- $10,000 housing subsidy for eligible households when a qualifying member becomes a Singapore Citizen
- The subsidy is converted into equal shares and credited fully into the CPF Ordinary Accounts of eligible family members
- Only core flat owners can use their share of the CPF housing grants to pay for the flat e.g. loan repayment
- The Citizen Top-Up can be used for a lump sum repayment or full redemption of an HDB housing loan
- For housing loans from financial institutions, you may additionally use it for monthly instalments
  - You must clear all outstanding housing loan arrears before you can use the grant for the above purposes
- If you have any remaining Citizen Top-Up balance and no housing loan, you may use it to buy another HDB flat in the future, or to form part of the CPF funds available for withdrawal under CPF rules at age 55
sections.Who is this for?:
- Households that have paid a $10,000 premium when buying a flat from HDB
- Households who received a reduced Family Grant for a resale flat, a Design Build and Sell Scheme flat or an Executive Condominium unit
- The Citizen Top-Up is granted when a Permanent Resident spouse, parent, child or sibling^ originally listed in the flat application obtains Singapore Citizenship, or when a Singapore Citizen child is born to the Singapore Citizen applicant and spouse originally listed in the flat application

^ For siblings, this qualification only applies to flats purchased as orphaned siblings or for families with a non-resident spouse.
sections.How to apply?:
Submit your application online:

- Use the [Application for Citizen Top-up e-Service](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg//webapp/AB22AWTopUpGrantWeb/AB22PMain#) within 6 months of meeting the citizenship criteria

title: Assistance Scheme for Second Timers (Divorced/ Widowed Parents) (ASSIST)
description: Allocates up to 5% of flats for eligible divorced or widowed parents applying for 2-room Flexi and 3-room BTO flats.
highlights: 5% of 2-room Flexi and 3-room Build-To-Order (BTO) flats allocated for eligible applicants

sections.About this support: Up to 5% of 2-room Flexi and 3-room BTO flats in non-mature estates are allocated to eligible applicants.
sections.Who is this for?:
- Divorced or widowed with at least one child (i.e. natural offspring from a legal marriage or legally adopted) aged 18 or below
- Adoptive parents must have the Adoption Order of their children when applying for a flat
- Must not have any interest in a HDB flat or private residential property after divorce / separation or spouse's demise, except for matrimonial flat / property
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain a HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/)
- If you meet the eligibility criteria during your HFE letter application, you may apply for this scheme in your flat application

title: Tenants' Priority Scheme (TPS)
description: Allocates up to 10% of Flexi / Build-To-Order (BTO) / Sale of Balance (SBF) flats for eligible HDB rental flat tenants to help them purchase a home.
highlights: Up to 10% of 2-room Flexi and 3-room BTO / SBF flats reserved for eligible tenants

sections.About this support: Up to 10% of 2-room Flexi and 3-room BTO or SBF flats are allocated to eligible applicants.
sections.Who is this for?: You and your family have been living in a HDB public rental flat for at least 2 years.
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain a HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/)
- If you meet the eligibility criteria during your HFE letter application, you may apply for this scheme in your flat application

title: Third Child Priority Scheme (TCPS)
description: Provides priority in flat allocation to eligible families with 3 or more children.
highlights: Up to 10% of Build-To-Order (BTO) flats, and up to 10% of Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) flats allocated for eligible families with 3 or more children
Provides an additional ballot chance to secure a flat

sections.About this support:
- Up to 10% of BTO flats, and up to 10% of SBF flats allocated for eligible families
- Parent(s) expecting their third child can apply for a flat under the TCPS subject to meeting all other eligibility conditions
sections.Who is this for?:
- You and/or your spouse are Singapore Citizens
- If you are divorced or widowed, you must be a Singapore Citizen to qualify
- Your family must consist of at least 3 children or be expecting a third child who are from a legal marriage or legally adopted
- If the family is expecting*, you must have a doctor’s certificate confirming the pregnancy
- Divorced parents must have legal custody, care, and control of their children
- Adoptive parents must provide the Adoption Order when applying for a flat
- Your third child must be born on or after 1 January 1987
- Your youngest child or the child you are expecting must be a Singapore Citizen
- Your other children must be either Singapore Citizens or Singapore Permanent Residents
- You have not previously bought a flat under the TCPS

*This includes cases where the parent(s) have 1 child and are expecting 2 or more children, or where the parent(s) do not have a child yet and are expecting 3 or more children.
sections.How to apply?:
- Obtain a HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter through the [HDB Flat Portal](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/web/bp27/PrelimHFE/)
- If you meet the eligibility criteria during your HFE letter application, you may apply for this scheme in your flat application

title: Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE)
description: Subsidy for Singapore Citizen households with at least one senior who meets age criterion and needs help to install senior-friendly fittings.
highlights: Up to 95% subsidy of improvement costs
Respond within 14 working days upon receipt of application
Apply via EASE e-Service or Mobile@HDB

- Depending on your flat type, the subsidy can cover up to 95% of the total improvement cost.

Singapore Citizen household with a senior who is aged:

- Between 60 and 64, and requires assistance for one or more of the Activities of Daily Living (ADLs):
  - Eating
  - Bathing
  - Dressing
  - Transferring
  - Toileting
  - Walking or moving around
sections.How to apply?:
You can apply:

- [Apply for Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE) Online via EASE](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/webapp/BN37AWEASE/BN37PMain.jsp)
- Mobile@HDB

You are required to submit a [Functional Assessment Report](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/-/media/managing-my-home/upgrading-and-redevelopment/enhancement-for-active-seniors-ease/FAR-Sep-2025.pdf) if you are a Singapore Citizen flat owner with at least one member in the household aged between 60 and 64 who requires assistance for one or more of the Activities of Daily Living (ADL)

title: Renting Out of HDB Flats
description: Enables eligible Singapore Citizen flat owners to rent out their HDB flat after meeting the Minimum Occupation Period.
highlights: Only Singapore Citizens can rent out HDB flats
Fulfill Minimum Occupation Period (MOP) before renting out (Prime and Plus flats cannot be rented out)
Non-Citizen Quota applies for non-Malaysian tenants
Approval from HDB required before renting out

sections.About this support:
- Receive rental income through renting out your flat where necessary

- Provide an option to seniors to monetise your flat and move to live with family members
sections.Who is this for?:
- Owner must be a Singapore Citizen to rent out the HDB flat. Singapore Permanent Residents are not allowed to do so.
- Fulfill a Minimum Occupation Period (MOP) of 5 years, or 3 years for non-subsidised flats purchased before 30 August 2010. Non-subsidised flats refer to those purchased from the open market without a housing grant. Owners of Prime and Plus flats are not allowed to rent out the flat even after the 10-year MOP. Owners of 2-room Flexi flats, Studio Apartments and Lease Buyback Scheme (LBS) flats are also not eligible to rent out their flat.
- MOP is calculated from the date of purchase or the effective date of transfer of flat ownership.
- Do consider the Non-Citizen Quota, if owners are renting to tenants who are non-Malaysian non-citizens (Singapore Permanent Residents or foreigners). Use [HDB’s e-Service](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/webapp/BR12AWNCQuota/) to check if your flat can be rented out to non-Malaysian non-citizens.
sections.How to apply?:
- Flat owners must ensure that they comply with the regulations listed on [HDB’s website](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/managing-my-home/home-ownership/renting-out-a-flat-or-bedrooms/renting-out-a-flat/eligibility) before renting out their flats. These include the number of tenants and their legal residency status.
- 'Apply/ Manage Application to Rent Out Flat' [e-Service](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg/webapp/BR12AWFlatRentOutApplication) or [MyHDB mobile app](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/myhdb-mobile-app). An administrative fee of $18 applies for each application.
- Notify HDB of any changes in rental details (e.g. changes to your tenants’ particulars or if your tenants move out of the flat) within 7 days, and obtain approval for new tenants before they move in.

description: Helps parents and their child(ren), married or single, to jointly apply for 2 units in the same Build-To-Order (BTO) project.
highlights: Parents and their child(ren), married or single, can make a joint application for 2 units in a BTO project that offers 2-room Flexi or 3-room flats.
